newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns Aaa rating to NTT's Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Aaa rating to NTT's Eurobonds.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had assigned an Aaa rating to Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's (NTT) 100 billion yen, 2.5 percent Eurobond offering due 2007.
This rating reflects NTT's dominant position in Japan's expanding telecommunications market and its excellent research and development capacity, Moody's said in a statement.

The rating agency said NTT's vital ongoing role in providing the infrastructure for Japan's transition to a more service-oriented economy is a role which should ensure continued strong regulatory and government support.
Moody's said it expects these factors to enable NTT to maintain its high credit quality in an environment of increasing competition.
